title: Iran blocks UN nuclear site visits until the war ends
detail: France 24 reports Iran is blocking UN nuclear inspectors' visits to its nuclear sites until the war ends. Details beyond the headline were not in the feed summary.

title: US Army major claims Pentagon ignored Kuwait base security warnings before March Iranian drone strike
detail: Times of India reports a US Army major claims the Pentagon ignored warnings about Kuwait base security before the March Iranian drone strike that killed 6 US troops. The claim is a whistleblower allegation as reported; it has not been independently verified here.
